articles.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
articles.snippet: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

articles.title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
articles.snippet: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.
